scenarios.name: Chokepoint disruption
scenarios.description: Fewer ships come through a strait or canal for a while, and the ports that depend on it receive less. Watch warehouse stock fall and towns' orders wait, then recover.
effects: Each port's arrivals fall by its share of ships through the chokepoint times the cut, for the chosen days.
Every town's orders change by the share given while the cut lasts (none by default).

scenarios.name: Chokepoint disruption, cargo diverted
scenarios.description: Fewer ships come through a strait or canal for a while, and part of the cargo kept out lands at a port outside it instead and is trucked inland from there. Watch that port's anchorage and yard, and the trucks on its lanes.
effects: Each port's arrivals fall by its share of ships through the chokepoint times the cut.
The diverted cargo arrives at the chosen port; its warehouses order it from there, and those lanes hire trucks for it.
The chosen port's berths keep their capacity, or take the capacity given from the disruption's first day to the end of the run.
Every town's orders change by the share given while the cut lasts (none by default).

scenarios.name: Road closure
scenarios.description: A road lane is closed, or restricted, for a while. Its trucks wait for it to reopen, take a detour, or the warehouse orders from its other ports. Watch the warehouse's stock fall, the lane's trucks get busy and the cargo wait at the port.
effects: Closed, the lane loads only its open share; trucks already on the road finish their trips.
On a detour, every trip takes longer over more kilometres.
Ordering from other ports moves the lane's share of the warehouse's orders to its other lanes, which ship only what their own ports hold.

scenarios.name: Fleet change
scenarios.description: The trucks on some lanes change: drivers are short, or the operator adds trucks. Watch what the lanes carry, their utilisation and their costs.
effects: Each lane's fleet of each size is hired or released towards the new number over its hiring time; only idle trucks are released.

scenarios.name: Demand surge
scenarios.description: Towns order more for a while, as on peak days. Watch warehouses run down, trucks fill up and orders wait.
effects: Each chosen town's demand rises by the share given, for the days given.
